t.SODIUM_LAURETH_SULFATE.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule. The hazard class of the pure substance (skin irritation, eye damage) applies to the concentrated form.
t.SODIUM_LAURETH_SULFATE.summary: The most common cleanser in shampoos and shower gels.
t.SODIUM_LAURETH_SULFATE.what: Removes dirt and oil with water and produces plenty of foam.
